explanation: The future king of Israel, who was a skilled warrior and musician, and who composed many of the Psalms.
The first king of Israel, who eventually fell out of favor with God and died in battle against the Philistines.
Saul's son and David's close friend, who also died fighting the Philistines.
A person from the Amalekites, who came to David with news of the deaths of Saul and Jonathan and claimed to have killed Saul himself.
A song or poem expressing grief and sorrow, often used in connection with death.
A city in Judah where David lived while hiding from King Saul.
An Old Testament people who were enemies of Israel, against whom King Saul and his army fought.
Another city in Judah where David lived and ruled over his men before he became king.
